title: Confluence: Otherworld x Fargo's Talismans Compat
description: A datapack that connects two Terraria mods: Confluence: Otherworld and Fargo's Talismans
body:
This datapack is what ive been using in my personal world, to connect the two Terraria-in-Minecraft mods. Currently, this is simply just by putting the Confluence item in the crafting table, and getting the Fargo's equivalent. Some items, however, have modified recipes as some items from Fargo's are not in Confluence. Those items are, with their new recipes:
- Aeolus Boots: Dunerider Boots, Fairy Boots, Sailfish Boots, Terraspark Boots, Frog Legs, and Green Horseshoe Balloon in any order
- Ancient Horn: Made with 6 Falling Stars, 1 Abominable Energy, a Sapphire Whip, and a Sandstorm In A Bottle
- Blessed Apple: Made with 6 Falling Stars, 1 Abominable Energy, a Amethyst Whip, and a Blizzard In A Bottle
- Brain Scrambler: Made with 6 Falling Stars, 1 Abominable Energy, a Jade Whip, and a Fart In A Jar
- Reindeer Bells: Made with 6 Falling Stars, 1 Abominable Energy, a Topaz Whip, and a Tsunami In A Bottle
